name: @magnetcustomer/sdk
description: SDK oficial da API da Magnet Customer para Node.js
author: Magnet Customer <suporte@magnetcustomer.com>

scripts.generate: python3 scripts/prepare_spec.py openapi.yaml .sdk-spec.yaml && openapi-generator-cli generate -i .sdk-spec.yaml -g typescript-axios -o src/generated --additional-properties=supportsES6=true,withSeparateModelsAndApi=true,apiPackage=api,modelPackage=models,useSingleRequestParameter=true,enumPropertyNaming=original && rm -rf src/generated/docs src/generated/git_push.sh src/generated/.gitignore src/generated/.npmignore .sdk-spec.yaml
